sentence: She ___ her jacket before going outside.
tip: Phrasal verb con <put>: ponerse ropa (2 palabras)
explanation: El phrasal verb <put on> significa ponerse una prenda de ropa.

sentence: I need to ___ the answer to this question.
tip: Phrasal verb con <find>: descubrir información (2 palabras)
explanation: El phrasal verb <find out> significa descubrir información.

sentence: He ___ the form at the doctor's office.
tip: Phrasal verb con <fill>: completar un formulario (2 palabras, pasado)
explanation: El phrasal verb <fill in> significa completar un formulario con información.

sentence: We ___ at the hotel at 3 pm.
tip: Phrasal verb con <check>: registrarse al llegar (2 palabras, pasado)
explanation: El phrasal verb <check in> significa registrarse en un hotel.

sentence: Can you ___ the music? I can't hear you.
tip: Phrasal verb con <turn>: bajar el volumen (2 palabras)
explanation: El phrasal verb <turn down> significa bajar el volumen.

sentence: She ___ her old clothes to charity.
tip: Phrasal verb con <give>: donar, regalar (2 palabras, pasado)
explanation: El phrasal verb <give away> significa donar o regalar algo.

sentence: They ___ the meeting until next week.
tip: Phrasal verb con <put>: posponer (2 palabras, pasado)
explanation: El phrasal verb <put off> significa posponer o aplazar.

sentence: She was walking on air after getting the job. This means she was very ___.
tip: Modismo: ¿cómo se siente alguien 'caminando en el aire'?
explanation: El modismo <walking on air> significa sentirse extremadamente feliz.

sentence: He's feeling blue today. This means he's feeling ___.
tip: Modismo: ¿qué emoción asocias con el color azul?
explanation: El modismo <feeling blue> significa sentirse triste o deprimido.

sentence: She ___ to the park yesterday.
tip: Transforma a pasado continuo: <She goes> → She ___ (was/were + -ing)
explanation: Pasado continuo: <was/were> + verbo-ing. She <was going>.

sentence: They ___ dinner when the phone rang.
tip: Pasado continuo con they + <have>: acción en progreso interrumpida
explanation: Pasado continuo con they: <were> + verbo-ing: <were having>.

sentence: I ___ to the cinema tomorrow.
tip: Transforma a futuro simple: <I go> → I ___ (will + verbo base)
explanation: Futuro simple: <will> + forma base: <will go>.

sentence: He ___ the homework yet.
tip: Transforma a presente perfecto negativo: <He finishes> → He ___ (hasn't + participio)
explanation: Presente perfecto negativo: <hasn't> + participio pasado: <hasn't finished>.

sentence: ___ you ever been to London?
tip: Pregunta en presente perfecto: ¿qué auxiliar va al inicio?
explanation: Pregunta en presente perfecto: <Have> + sujeto + participio pasado.

sentence: The act of moving to a new country is called ___.
tip: Formación: migrate + sufijo sustantivo → ?
explanation: Agregar <-tion> al verbo <migrate> forma el sustantivo <migration>.

sentence: The state of being happy is called ___.
tip: Formación: happy + sufijo de estado → ?
explanation: Agregar <-ness> a <happy> forma el sustantivo <happiness>.

sentence: Something done in a quick way is done ___.
tip: Formación: quick + sufijo de adverbio → ?
explanation: Agregar <-ly> al adjetivo <quick> forma el adverbio <quickly>.

sentence: A person who manages is a ___.
tip: Formación: manage + sufijo de persona → ?
explanation: Agregar <-er> a <manage> forma el sustantivo <manager>.

sentence: The improve___ of the road took two months.
tip: Formación: improve + sufijo <-ment> → ?
explanation: Agregar <-ment> a <improve> forma el sustantivo <improvement>.

sentence: She ___ to the party last night.
tip: Corrige el error: 'She goed' → usa el pasado irregular de <go>
explanation: <Go> es irregular. El pasado es <went>, no <goed>.
